clips.title: The story
paras: Baradin Bay is the expansive body of water lying between the shores of Khaz Modan, the Wetlands, the Arathi Highlands, and southern Lordaeron. Once vigorously patrolled by the powerful navy of Kul Tiras during the Second War, its waters now conceal treacherous reefs, sunken warships, and hostile aquatic predators.

Framed by the coasts of Dun Morogh to the south and Lordaeron to the north, Baradin Bay serves as a vital maritime passage connecting the harbors of the Eastern Kingdoms. The bay is anchored by busy ports like Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands and Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. However, navigating these waters is perilous: shallow sandbanks, jagged shoals, and dangerous fauna like murlocs, crocolisks, and deep-sea sharks pose constant threats to sailors and travelers alike.

During the Second War, Baradin Bay witnessed heavy naval conflict as the fleets of Kul Tiras clashed with the Horde. Today, grim reminders of those battles litter the coast and the seabed. The shattered hulls of the Kul Tiran Third Fleet—known locally as the Lost Fleet—rest half-submerged along the Wetlands coast, while other vessels have plummeted down to Drowned Reef. Hostile spirits, opportunistic salvagers, and ravenous sea beasts now haunt the waters surrounding these decaying timber ruins.
